A Schedule resource holds Run directives that say when the jobs that use it start, at which level and with which overrides.

## Examples

**Monthly Full, weekly Differential, daily Incremental**

```text
Schedule {
  Name = WeeklyCycle
  Description = "Full on the first Sunday, differential on the other Sundays, incremental daily"
  Run = Full 1st sun at 23:05
  Run = Differential 2nd-5th sun at 23:05
  Run = Incremental mon-sat at 23:05
}
```

**Overrides per run**

```text
Schedule {
  Name = Monthly
  Run = Level=Full Pool=Monthly 1st sat at 21:00
  Run = Level=Incremental Pool=Daily Priority=5 mon-fri at 22:30
}
```

## Directives

| Directive | Type | Default | | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Name](#d-name) | name |  | required | Name of the schedule; jobs refer to it with Schedule. |
| [Description](#d-description) | string |  |  | Free text describing the schedule. |
| [Run](#d-run) | schedule run |  |  | When the jobs of this schedule run, one directive per rule: optional level and overrides, then the date and time specification. |
| [Enabled](#d-enabled) | yes\|no | `yes` |  | A disabled schedule starts no job; enable schedule and disable schedule change it at run time. |

### Name {#d-name}

Key: `name` · Type: name · Required

Name of the schedule; jobs refer to it with Schedule.

```text
Schedule {
  Name = "WeeklyCycle"
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure add schedule name=WeeklyCycle
```

### Description {#d-description}

Key: `description` · Type: string

Free text describing the schedule. The Onesimus GUI shows and edits it in the grid editor.

```text
Schedule {
  Name = WeeklyCycle
  Description = "Full on the first Sunday, incrementals daily"
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure update schedule=WeeklyCycle description="Full on the first Sunday, incrementals daily"
```

### Run {#d-run}

Key: `run` · Type: schedule run

When the jobs of this schedule run, one directive per rule: optional level and overrides, then the date and time specification. See the Run block for the syntax. The Onesimus Director checks Run lines like the C++ Director and refuses an invalid one before writing it.

```text
Schedule {
  Name = WeeklyCycle
  Run = Full 1st sun at 23:05
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure update schedule=WeeklyCycle run="Full 1st sun at 23:05"
```

### Enabled {#d-enabled}

Key: `enabled` · Type: yes|no · Default: `yes` · Values: `yes`, `no`

A disabled schedule starts no job; enable schedule and disable schedule change it at run time.

```text
Schedule {
  Name = WeeklyCycle
  Enabled = yes
}
```

In the console:

```text
configure update schedule=WeeklyCycle enabled=yes
```

## Run block {#block-run}

Syntax of a Run directive: \[level\] \[overrides\] \[date specification\] \[at HH:MM\]. The parts of the date specification combine: "1st sun" is the first Sunday, "mon-fri" every working day, "on 1 jan" the first of January. Without a date specification the run is daily. Words are case-insensitive; # starts a comment.

| Directive | Type | Default | | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Level](#b-run-level) | enum |  |  | The level of the run, written as a word (Full) or as Level=Full. |
| [Pool override](#b-run-pool) | resource |  |  | Pool=, FullPool=, IncrementalPool=, DifferentialPool= and NextPool= replace the pools of the job for this run. |
| [Other overrides](#b-run-overrides) | string |  |  | Storage=, Messages=, Priority=, SpoolData=yes\|no, Accurate=yes\|no and MaxRunSchedTime= replace the job's settings for this run. |
| [Weekday](#b-run-weekday) | string |  |  | mon ... sun (or monday ... sunday), single or as a range mon-fri; several separated by commas. |
| [Week of the month](#b-run-wom) | string |  |  | 1st ... 5th (or first ... fifth), ranges such as 2nd-5th; last means the last seven days of the month. |
| [Day of the month](#b-run-mday) | string |  |  | Numbers 1 to 31, ranges such as 1-7, written with on: "on 1 at 01:05". n/m means every m-th day starting with day n (1/2: odd days). |
| [Month](#b-run-month) | string |  |  | jan ... dec (or the full names), single, as list or range. |
| [Week of the year](#b-run-woy) | string |  |  | w00 ... w53 (ISO weeks); wNN/wMM means every MM-th week starting with week NN. |
| [Daily, weekly, monthly, hourly](#b-run-period) | string |  |  | daily (every day), weekly (on Sunday), monthly (the first of the month) and hourly (every hour, at the minute given by at). |
| [Time](#b-run-at) | string |  |  | at HH:MM in 24-hour time (am/pm are accepted). |

### Level {#b-run-level}

Key: `level` · Type: enum · Values: `Full`, `Incremental`, `Differential`, `VirtualFull`, `Catalog`, `InitCatalog`, `VolumeToCatalog`, `DiskToCatalog`, `Data`

The level of the run, written as a word (Full) or as Level=Full. Without it the job's Level applies. Base and Since are accepted; the Onesimus Director then keeps the job's level.

```text
Run = Level=Full 1st sun at 23:05
```

### Pool override {#b-run-pool}

Key: `pool` · Type: resource

Pool=, FullPool=, IncrementalPool=, DifferentialPool= and NextPool= replace the pools of the job for this run.

```text
Run = Full Pool=Monthly 1st sun at 23:05
```

### Other overrides {#b-run-overrides}

Key: `overrides` · Type: string

Storage=, Messages=, Priority=, SpoolData=yes|no, Accurate=yes|no and MaxRunSchedTime= replace the job's settings for this run.

```text
Run = Incremental Priority=5 Storage=File2 mon-fri at 21:00
```

### Weekday {#b-run-weekday}

Key: `weekday` · Type: string

mon ... sun (or monday ... sunday), single or as a range mon-fri; several separated by commas.

```text
Run = Incremental mon-sat at 23:05
```

### Week of the month {#b-run-wom}

Key: `wom` · Type: string

1st ... 5th (or first ... fifth), ranges such as 2nd-5th; last means the last seven days of the month. Combined with a weekday: "1st sun".

```text
Run = Differential 2nd-5th sun at 23:05
```

### Day of the month {#b-run-mday}

Key: `mday` · Type: string

Numbers 1 to 31, ranges such as 1-7, written with on: "on 1 at 01:05". n/m means every m-th day starting with day n (1/2: odd days).

```text
Run = Full on 1 at 01:05
```

### Month {#b-run-month}

Key: `month` · Type: string

jan ... dec (or the full names), single, as list or range.

```text
Run = Full on 1 jan, jul at 02:00
```

### Week of the year {#b-run-woy}

Key: `woy` · Type: string

w00 ... w53 (ISO weeks); wNN/wMM means every MM-th week starting with week NN.

```text
Run = Full w01/w02 sun at 03:00
```

### Daily, weekly, monthly, hourly {#b-run-period}

Key: `period` · Type: string

daily (every day), weekly (on Sunday), monthly (the first of the month) and hourly (every hour, at the minute given by at).

```text
Run = Incremental hourly at 0:15
```

### Time {#b-run-at}

Key: `at` · Type: string

at HH:MM in 24-hour time (am/pm are accepted). Without at the run starts at 00:00 (hourly: at :00). Several times need several Run lines.

```text
Run = Incremental daily at 23:05
```

See also: [configuration reference](../), [`configure`](/docs/commands/configure/), [`show`](/docs/commands/show/)
